# Font licences

| Family | File | Designer | Licence | Used for |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Inter 4.001 (variable, weights 400–800, optical sizes 14–32, Latin subset) | inter-variable-latin.woff2 | Rasmus Andersson | SIL Open Font License 1.1 (`OFL-1.1.txt`) | Every page's sans |
| Source Serif 4 (variable, weights 400–500, Latin subset) | source-serif-4-variable-latin.woff2 | Adobe (Frank Grießhammer) | SIL Open Font License 1.1 | Quotations in a lesson |

The Inter file is cut from `frontiers-brand/fonts/InterVariable.ttf` (weights clamped, Latin subset); the serif is
the same file `frontiers-nature-web` ships. Both are the files `frontiers-slides` ships.
